name: gpscrape
description: Read-only Google Play data: app details, search, charts, reviews, permissions, data safety.
long_description: Twelve read-only tools over public Google Play Store pages: search, app details, charts, one page of reviews at a time, similar apps, developer listings, permissions, data safety, suggestions, categories and per-country availability. No account or API key. Text from the store is third-party data and is marked as such.
